Title: Blueprint publish fails or blocks tenant launch
Immediate Containment: Hold publish, inspect validation result, fix config, retry publish
Primary Admin Screens: Blueprint Publish Console, Config Drift Dashboard

Title: Tenant config appears visible across tenant boundary
Detection Signal: tenant_scope_denied_total spike; report from user/admin; inconsistent tenant_id in logs
Immediate Containment: Freeze affected tenant ops, inspect audit, verify RLS, revoke support sessions, evidence package
Primary Admin Screens: Tenant Detail, Audit Log Explorer, Policy Violation Viewer

Title: Payment provider webhook failures or invalid signatures
Immediate Containment: Pause activation, verify provider secret/config, inspect webhook log, replay safe events

Title: Payment provider ledger and Project-B payment refs diverge
Detection Signal: payment confirmed at provider but not in Project-B or duplicate state
Immediate Containment: Run reconciliation, mark disputed records, block activation until resolved

Title: Agreement provider status missing or inconsistent
Immediate Containment: Verify provider health, manually inspect agreement ref, block activation if unsigned

Title: Core access adapter unavailable
Immediate Containment: Deny-by-default for sensitive ops, communicate degraded access, retry adapter, open Core incident

Title: Assignment, enrollment and access state inconsistent
Detection Signal: client cannot access assigned journey; enrollment state mismatch
Immediate Containment: Inspect assignment/enrollment/access, rebuild projection, request Core check
Primary Admin Screens: Enrollment Inspector, Member Home Projection Inspector

Title: Member home or delivery projection stale beyond SLO
Immediate Containment: Rebuild projection, inspect worker checkpoint, monitor outbox

Title: Notification provider degraded or failing
Immediate Containment: Suppress retries if provider down, keep schedule state, communicate delay

Title: Coach/client messages not delivered or stuck
Detection Signal: message send fails or notification delivery fails
Immediate Containment: Inspect thread, notification state, provider status, retry allowed events

Title: Community receives abuse/spam report spike
Immediate Containment: Lock offending content, escalate severe abuse, apply moderation action, preserve evidence

Title: Moderation requires platform intervention
Detection Signal: tenant moderator cannot resolve; policy violation severe
Immediate Containment: Restrict content, capture evidence, coordinate platform decision

Title: Outbox lag exceeds operational SLO
Immediate Containment: Inspect worker, provider, DB locks; restart worker; DLQ if required

Title: Dead letter queue grows or contains critical event
Detection Signal: DLQ count above threshold or payment/access event DLQ
Immediate Containment: Classify DLQ events, patch cause, replay only safe events

Title: Replay request fails or causes conflict
Immediate Containment: Stop replay, inspect inbox/outbox state, reconcile projection manually

Title: Possible exposure of client/tenant data
Detection Signal: user report; audit anomaly; tenant scope breach
Immediate Containment: Contain, preserve evidence, revoke sessions, assess data, notify per policy

Title: Role assignment or auth boundary incorrect
Detection Signal: role forbidden spike or unauthorized access report
Immediate Containment: Freeze role changes, inspect role assignments, revoke invalid roles

Title: RLS policy behaves incorrectly
Detection Signal: tenant isolation test fails or audit anomaly
Immediate Containment: Block deployment, run RLS smoke tests, rollback migration

Title: Provider adapter degraded: payment/calendar/notification/agreement
Immediate Containment: Route to provider-specific runbook; communicate degraded function

Title: Project-B API unavailable or degraded
Detection Signal: health check fails; API latency/error budget burn
Immediate Containment: Declare incident, stabilize API, rollback if required

Title: Audit writes failing or delayed
Immediate Containment: Fail closed, stop mutating flows, restore audit store

Title: Analytics/revenue/progress projection inconsistent
Immediate Containment: Rebuild analytics projections, mark dashboard caveat
